description: Public synthetic YunusPi architecture memories. No private session content. Exact, conceptual, multilingual and unrelated queries; relevant IDs are authored before live comparison. The final six held-out queries were added after candidate thresholds were frozen; their results do not tune thresholds.

memories.text: Do not create parallel helper systems when the harness already exposes the required capability. Reuse the existing abstraction and coordinate its consumers.
A release is complete only when GitHub main, the annotated version tag, green CI attestations and the installed pi and yunuspi commands identify the same harness.
An asynchronous reviewer once delivered advice into the next session after the user switched projects. Capture the session owner and reject results from an obsolete generation.
Stable instructions belong at the beginning of a prompt. Append changing task context after the shared prefix so provider KV caches and local llama.cpp checkpoints can be reused.
Repeated identical failing tool calls exhausted the task budget. The anti-loop guard bounds repetition, applies backpressure, and requires a changed recovery strategy.
The main session keeps the model chosen by the user. Child roles resolve an ordered preference chain, validate capabilities and thinking levels, then use healthy economical fallbacks.
PI_MEMORY_EMBEDDER selects needle, openrouter or auto. PI_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_MODEL defaults to qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b for OpenRouter.
Vectors produced by different embedding models cannot share cosine comparisons, even when their dimensions match. Persist the model and dimension and explicitly backfill compatible vectors.
Use AST, language servers and project intelligence for symbol definitions and references. Embedding retrieval complements structural navigation with durable historical concepts.
The small local Qwen model handles narrow bounded classification tasks. Weak confidence must abstain; it cannot authorize destructive actions or replace deterministic correctness checks.
The observer should recall user corrections, previously rejected approaches and regressions before suggesting another change. Suggestions are evidence-backed advice rather than new requirements.
Mr. Watchmaker measures time versus progress. Review whether repeated reads or stalled delegation are wasting the session, and offer one practical way to finish sooner.
Before sending memory text to a remote embedding provider, redact authorization headers, passwords, private keys, API credentials and secret environment values.
FTS5 and BM25 preserve exact filenames, identifiers, error codes and commit references. Reciprocal-rank fusion combines lexical evidence with semantic candidates without discarding exact evidence.
The Jev and Kev OpenRouter decision models share small judging tasks. Healthy routes split traffic; a failing route cools while its peer serves bounded failover requests.
Content hashes skip unchanged memory chunks. Migration replaces only incompatible embeddings in bounded resumable batches, preserving SQLite provenance and lexical indexes.
Token savings are useful only while output quality stays high. Compare retrieval regressions, false matches, latency and actual cost before claiming a larger model is better.
Kullanıcı düzeltmeleri kalıcı proje bilgisidir. Daha önce reddedilen bir yaklaşımı yeni oturumda tekrar önermeden önce geçmiş kararları ve gerekçelerini hatırla.
Concurrent harness engineers use isolated worktrees and inspect the latest remote changes before release. Never reset another contributor's uncommitted work.
ERR_ROUTE_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH means the selected endpoint cannot satisfy the required tool or reasoning contract. Refresh capability metadata before resolving a fallback.
The previous interface review fixed keyboard focus visibility and tab order. Screen reader labels should describe actual controls and the TUI should show honest running and degraded states.
Bash execution uses the existing security boundary and bounded control policies. A local advisory classifier must never bypass permission or filesystem safety enforcement.
Investigate remote embedding cooldowns after HTTP 429. Repeated retries while a provider is rate limited waste latency and credits; lexical retrieval should remain usable.
The proposal to automatically summarize every raw tool response was rejected: terminal exhaust outweighed curated decisions and consumed tokens without improving durable recall.
